links.outcome: LLM answer accuracy and comprehensiveness rated by expert physicians against ratings
links.effect: Accuracy differed significantly across models (P=0.005). 25% (4/16) of Model A responses rated good vs 75% (12/16) for Models B and D.
links.quote: 25% (4/16) of Model A responses were rated as "good", which was lower than the 75% (12/16) for both Model B and Model D (both P<0.05).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the accuracy and comprehensiveness of four LLMs answering patient questions regarding placenta accreta spectrum disorders. It benchmarks model performance without testing a deployment practice or safeguard.
